title: SEBI Eases NISM Certification for RMs & Sales Staff
description: SEBI has simplified the National Institute of Securities Markets (NISM) certification requirements for specific roles in the financial sector. This relaxation.

faq.a: NISM (National Institute of Securities Markets) certifications are examinations mandated by SEBI to ensure that professionals in the Indian securities market possess a minimum level of knowledge and competence for their respective roles.

faq.q: Who does this change apply to?
faq.a: This change primarily applies to relationship managers, sales executives, and other non-core staff in investment advisory firms whose roles do not involve providing direct investment advice.

faq.q: Does this mean advisors no longer need NISM certification?
faq.a: No, certified investment advisors and other professionals directly involved in providing advice or making recommendations will still need to hold the relevant, more comprehensive NISM certifications for their specific roles.

faq.q: When do these new norms come into effect?
faq.a: The revised guidelines are effective immediately, meaning firms can begin implementing these changes in their compliance and training frameworks.

While easing compliance for firms, this move ensures that support staff still have foundational market knowledge, leading to better client service. Crucially, it allows firms to focus their resources on ensuring that direct advisors are highly qualified, thereby maintaining robust investor protection standards.

faq.q: Where can I find the official SEBI notification?
faq.a: The official notification and further details can be found on the SEBI website (https://sebi.gov.in). You can also refer to market news outlets like Livemint for summaries.
